claim: Blood stacks space three ways and the choice is forced: enclosed room over enclosed room is plain plan overlap; a space you must SEE into is room-over-room; anything over an OPEN space must be a deck of blocking floor-aligned sprites, because a sector over an open volume cannot be separated from it in z (37 of 43 campaign maps use blocking floor-aligned sprites, and 37 use plan overlap). BB4's regular grammar: 32,768 z of clear height per layer (1.93 bodies), an 8,192 slab, 40,960 floor to floor.
evidence: tools/mine_layers.py, knowledge/blood/design/layers-v1.json technique_usage (2026-08-28): blocking_floor_aligned_sprite 37 maps (0.8605), plan_overlap 37, both 34; BB4 has 71 sectors, 68 plan overlaps and no z clash.
use: Pick the technique by what lies below; take storey heights from BB4's grammar.
